diagnosis: The long-polling endpoint listens for incoming customer support messages by ticketId without checking if req.customer.id is the ticket requester. Any customer can eavesdrop on private customer support conversations, including sensitive account recovery discussions.
exploit_request:
GET /api/support/tickets/tkt_vip_account_recovery_01/long-poll HTTP/1.1
Host: helpdesk.cloudservice.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
